gaming_reaudit.what: the constrained selected M1 and the constrained A12 row on val k0-2 (14 cells x k0-2), before Select+Test
gaming_reaudit.tools: runs/audits/phase2-mid-gaming/scripts (analyze.py, giant.py, attraction.py, rules.py) run unchanged on a private root, with the PRESET.md thresholds (S1-S4, cap min(2/N, 1/N + 0.25)), plus learned_routing.window_guards
gaming_reaudit.outcome_rule: A11.2 prescribes one remedy (sign-constrained re-run at the same B), which is applied. The constrained M1 stays the M1 arm whatever the re-audit finds; any remaining cap violation, S1-S4 flag, dump worker or long-request deficit is reported as a flag on every M1 row and is not a reason to retune again (a different objective, e.g. request-size weighting, is a design decision for the operator).

report_flags.rows: every M1 row (m1 constrained, A12 constrained, m1u and m1u-A12 flagged) and every test finalist, in the test pass and in every robustness condition (A5 lag 0/50/200 ms, timing perturbations)
report_flags.metrics: learned_routing.window_guards per record, means over k: share_max_window vs cap (concentration flag: share > cap), nmi_worker_islq (segregation flag: > 0.10, the contender ceiling in the gaming audit), good_isl_ge_32k and good_isl_ge_64k and good_top_isl_decile (long-request sacrifice flag: more than 0.05 below default@defaults on the same cell), dump_workers (flag: > 0), worker_good_frac_min
report_flags.isl_strata: the record's isl_buckets (32768-65536 and >= 65536) and window_guards' >= 32K / >= 64K fractions are reported next to the headline

timing_robustness.rule: every timing-perturbed test record (PLAN stage 5 speedup_ratio / decode_speedup_ratio 0.8 and 1.2, and any other timing override) is scored twice with learned_routing.rescore_timing: nominal E0 (fixed absolute SLO, lr-eval's goodput_rps_window) and consistent E0' = prefill/s + decode/(s d) (SLO re-anchored to the perturbed engine). Both are reported.
timing_robustness.lr14_spread: the LR-14 perturbation spread and the ranking's Kendall tau are defined on E0' (consistent); the nominal-E0 numbers are reported alongside
timing_robustness.degenerate_flag: AgentX at speedup 0.8 is flagged degenerate under nominal E0 (no zero-reuse request can be good: min e2e/E0 1.2136 > S = 1.16134; sim-exploitation audit agentx_zero_reuse.json)
